1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.e3 O-O 5.Bd.strategy: Develops, adds a defender to d4 and prepares to castle. White keeps the centre intact and leaves Black the next decision: how to use the pressure on d4 while the bishop still pins c3.
Prepares ...Bb7, adding pressure on e4 and the central light squares, while the c5 pawn keeps working against d4. Black can trade on d4 later and play for activity against a possible isolated pawn.
